_doc: History tile (#264, #265): emulator src/core/history.ts; firmware core/history.cpp + core/config.cpp run these (#268, test_core). Times are epoch ms; tz = local UTC offset in minutes. Compare floats with a 1e-6 tolerance. config: like config/*.json. defaultBucket: window/cs → bucket (null = needs an explicit bucket). spec: historySpec of a parsed widget. history: HA history rows (s, lu seconds) → fromHistoryRows → bucketize per agg. statistics: rows → fromStatistics per agg (statsType picks the field). yScale, lowHigh (times as shown, en and nl), dayLowHigh (values = one day in n buckets), axis (x 0..1 across the span).

config.name: history-defaults
config.description: A history tile needs only a numeric entity: window 24h, bucket from the ladder (≤ 12 bars per column), agg mean, style auto. Other keys are kept as written.

config.name: history-wrong-domain
config.description: Rule: the entity must be a sensor / input_number / number.
config.input:
# HA Paper display config
version: 1
screens:
  - id: a
    widgets:
      - {type: history, entity: binary_sensor.door, cs: 4}

expect.message: history: “binary_sensor.door” is not a sensor / input_number / number entity

# HA Paper display config

expect.message: history: “undefined” is not a sensor / input_number / number entity

config.name: history-window-bare-number
config.description: Rule: a window needs a unit (24 is a number in the dialect).
config.input:
# HA Paper display config
version: 1

    widgets:
      - {type: history, entity: sensor.outdoor_temperature, window: 24}

expect.message: history: window must be like 30m, 6h or 7d (10m–7d)

config.name: history-styles
config.description: Styles area, step, dots (#304); threshold is a number (negative / decimal), labels true or false. Kept as written.

expect.yaml:
# HA Paper display config
version: 1
screens:
  - id: a
    app: home
    title: a
    widgets:
      - {type: history, entity: sensor.outdoor_temperature, style: area, threshold: 18, labels: true, cs: 4}
      - {type: history, entity: sensor.price, style: step, threshold: -0.5, labels: false, cs: 4}
  - id: b
    app: home
    title: b
    widgets:
      - {type: history, entity: sensor.rain, style: dots, threshold: 2.5, cs: 4}

config.name: history-seven-tiles
config.description: Rule: at most 6 history tiles in the whole config; the 7th fails on its own line.

history.name: 1h-5m
history.description: 1 h of 5-minute buckets; one row before the window carries in; a gap (unavailable) from row 5 to 7.

history.name: 6h-30m
history.description: 6 h of 30-minute buckets; data starts inside the window, so the first buckets are empty.

history.name: 24h-1h-counter
history.description: 24 h of hourly buckets on a counter: change = last held minus last held before; a :30 time zone (tz +330).

history.name: 10m-1m-sparse
history.description: 10 min of 1-minute buckets; a single change before the window holds through all of it.

statistics.name: 24h-2h-hourly
statistics.description: Hourly statistics into 2-hour buckets (period hour); the open bucket has no row yet.

statistics.name: 7d-6h-hourly
statistics.description: 7 days of 6-hour buckets from hourly rows; rows outside the span are ignored.
